text:
```yaml
name: CI - Lazer Sui Contract

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: lazer/contracts/sui
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Sui CLI
        run: |
          curl -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MystenLabs/sui/main/dotenv/.env -o .env
          source .env
          SUI_VERSION=${SUI_VERSION:-1.34.0}
          curl -L https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/releases/download/${SUI_VERSION}/sui-${SUI_VERSION}-ubuntu-x64.tgz -o sui.tgz
          tar -xzf sui.tgz
          sudo mv sui /usr/local/bin/
          sui --version

      - name: Run Sui Move Tests
        run: sui move test
```
